intro.title: 3Sum
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a function that solves the 3Sum problem: finding all unique triplets in an array that add up to zero. You will learn the core concept of using a two-pointer technique to efficiently search for combinations without checking every possible set. The main technologies involved are JavaScript arrays, loops, and conditional logic. This is a beginner-friendly introduction to a common algorithmic pattern used in coding interviews and real-world applications.
intro.usecase: The 3Sum algorithm solves a fundamental pattern-matching problem that appears in many real-world applications. In e-commerce platforms, it's used to find product combinations that meet specific price targets or discount thresholds. Financial analysis tools apply it to identify investment trios that sum to target returns or risk levels. Data dashboards use similar logic to filter datasets where three metrics combine to reach critical thresholds, helping analysts spot trends and correlations.
